conventions.convention: All state dimensions are nonnegative integers. R^0 has one empty vector, and its unique square matrix acts as the identity. Mass matrices are real symmetric positive definite; S is symmetric positive semidefinite; DC=CG=0.
The equations are M_e e'=C^T M_b b-Se-j and b'=-Ce. Energy is W=(e^T M_e e+b^T M_b b)/2, and q=-G^T M_e e. These are finite mathematical data without an assumed mesh or continuum interpretation.

Leapfrog uses S=0 and j=0, h>0, and an integer N≥0. At each n=0,...,N-1 it updates b first, then solves the electric mass equation exactly. Initial magnetic data are indexed -1/2; N=0 returns only the initial vectors.

Positive mass roots use positive square roots of eigenvalues; empty roots are the unique empty matrices. K=M_b^(1/2) C M_e^(-1/2), its norm is zero on a zero-dimensional domain, and strict CFL means h||K||₂<2. The modified energy has cross term -h y^T Kx.

load_bearing.statement: For the specified finite real matrices, continuous j on an open interval I, and C¹ states, the system is M_e e'=C^T M_b b-Se-j, b'=-Ce. Its energy is W=(e^T M_e e+b^T M_b b)/2, magnetic constraint is Db, and weak-divergence coordinate is q=-G^T M_e e. If the columns of G form a basis of ker C, then q=0 exactly when M_e e∈im C^T.
For every t₀∈I and initial pair, continuous forcing gives a unique C¹ solution on all of I. It satisfies W'=-e^TSe-e^Tj, Db(t)=Db(t₀), and q'=G^T(Se+j).

For the unforced system with S=0, perform N updates b_(n+1/2)=b_(n-1/2)-hCe_n, solve M_e v_n=C^T M_b b_(n+1/2) exactly, and set e_(n+1)=e_n+h v_n; output the specified integer-indexed electric and half-integer-indexed magnetic vectors.

The algorithm terminates after N updates and preserves Db. Under h||K||₂<2 it preserves E_h=(||x||₂²+||y||₂²-hy^TKx)/2, bounded below and above by (1∓h||K||₂/2)(||x||₂²+||y||₂²)/2. If h||K||₂>2, a largest-singular-value mode has a real update eigenvalue of modulus greater than one and corresponding eigenvector states grow by that factor each update. No stability claim is made at equality.

seams_checked.note: Checked the supplier interfaces against def-emx-whitney-semidescretization and pthm-emx-discrete-maxwell-balance. The assembled matrices have the required symmetry, positivity and DC=CG=0 identities; continuity of each load coordinate follows from the fixed L² pairing. The consumer uses precisely the global finite-dimensional existence, energy and constraint identities, retaining q=-G^T M_e e. The mathematical suppliers impose no mesh, continuum convergence or physical-realization conclusion, and the physical consumer does not attribute one to them. No reverse logical dependency occurs.
